Rippin Lips Lake Erie Charters
listings.description: A guided Lake Erie walleye and perch fishing charter run by Captain Aric Rothlisberger, operating alongside the same owner's Tattered Wings waterfowl guide service. Trips troll, jig or cast for walleye and perch in Ohio's western basin.

listings.name: Holiday Harbor Marina
amenities: Boat service and repair (boats up to 20 tons)
listings.description: A family-owned full-service marina on the Huron River about one mile from Lake Erie, offering seasonal dockage, boat service and winter storage. It is the sister facility to Huron Lagoons Marina and holds Gold status in the Ohio Clean Marina Program.

listings.name: the Vikings Den - Huron, Ohio
amenities: Free boat docking while you dine
listings.description: Waterfront restaurant inside Huron Lagoons Marina on the Huron River, where diners can look out at the water and the wildlife. Boaters can dock free of charge while they eat.

listings.name: Freedom Boat Club Lake Erie - Huron
North Coast Boating
listings.description: A boating instruction business staffed by Coast Guard-licensed instructors, offering free beginner seminars, on-the-water handling training, and advanced navigation and licensing courses. It also provides vessel delivery services across the Great Lakes, Eastern Canada and the East Coast.

listings.name: Huron Lagoons Marina
amenities: Pool house with restrooms and showers
Indoor and outdoor winter boat storage
listings.description: Huron's largest full-service marina, family-owned for over 60 years and located on the Huron River in Erie County about one mile inland from Lake Erie. It offers yearly and guest dockage, boat sales and service, winter storage, a ships store with a fuel dock, and a waterfront restaurant.

listings.name: Two Rivers Waterfront Homes in Huron
Salvation Army
listings.description: A Salvation Army Service Unit serving Huron and Erie County. Per the Northeast Ohio Division: "A Service Unit is located in a community church building or other facility, run solely by volunteers, and may offer a full limited array of services such as: Utilities, Prescriptions, Food vouchers and pantries, Gasoline, Rent & lodging, Back to school supplies, Coats for Kids, Residential Camping, Angel Tree".

listings.name: Huron Helping Hands Food Pantry
listings.description: A food pantry at 607 S. Main St that, in its own words, "provides food and hope to families across Huron, Berlin Heights, and the 44839 area." Walk-ins are welcome during regular hours and no income verification is required.

listings.name: Huron Sports Academy
listings.description: A tuition-free, K-6 public charter school that integrates Ohio state academic standards with daily competitive athletics and physical conditioning, which it calls "the Blitz Model." It serves families across Huron, Sandusky, Vermilion, Norwalk, Firelands, Berlin Heights and Perkins Township.

listings.name: Berardi's Restaurant

It describes itself as "A Place of Grace" with a mission to "engage with Christ and our community to spread God's promise of hope, peace, joy, and love to the world."

Principal: Tim Lamb.
